name: Akio no Meitantei
source:
A shocking bonus content that destroys the world of Harumade, Kururu. and regenerates it in a completely different direction.

Taking the form of a nostalgic command-based ADV, the production team dives headfirst into a mysterious incident driven purely by their own bad taste—but as for the truth of that incident? Who cares, really! This unexpectedly well-made mystery content will either double the charm of Harukuru or annihilate it entirely!
translation:
将《はるまで、くるる。》（《直到春天，来临。》）的世界彻底粉碎、并朝着截然不同的方向重塑再生的冲击性特典内容！

本作采用充满怀旧气息的指令选择式冒险游戏形式，制作团队纯粹出于一己恶趣味，一头扎进了一桩离奇事件之中——至于事件的真相究竟如何？管它呢，根本无所谓啦！这部意外制作精良的悬疑推理特典，究竟会让《はるくる》的魅力翻倍，还是将其彻底毁灭殆尽呢？！
